ai_summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited (AMS) has successfully handed over its indigenously developed Safety & Detonation Device (SDD) to the Indian Navy, a strategic achievement replacing imported equipment and bolstering national defense self-reliance. While this positions AMS for significant potential future production orders and follow-on programs, the company explicitly clarifies that this handover does not constitute a firm commercial contract, indicating revenue generation from this specific event remains prospective.
